stories.headline: XPeng unveils IRON humanoid robot under its Turing Physical AI Architecture, targeting mass production from January 2027 at roughly EV price
stories.summary: XPeng unveiled its IRON humanoid robot and Turing Physical AI Architecture (VLA 3.0) at AI Day, saying mass production starts January 2027 and the robot will be trained as a retail assistant in XPeng stores before sale at around the median EV price of US$18,000 to US$44,000. Sources differ on timing details, with some reports citing a 2027 release and others a Q2 2027 sales target.
stories.reason: covered by Bloomberg, Reuters-syndicated outlets, Nikkei Asia, Seeking Alpha, Digital Trends; primary source (XPENG GlobeNewswire release)

stories.headline: California DMV bars Waymo from freeways after safety incidents; Waymo recalls robotaxis and faces US probe
stories.summary: California's DMV ordered Waymo off freeways citing safety incidents, Waymo reportedly recalled 4,488 units tied to closed-lane and highway issues, and the US government is investigating robotaxis passing school buses. Separately, a loaded handgun was found in a San Francisco Waymo, prompting a service review.
stories.reason: covered by Mashable, SlashGear, NBC News, Reuters-sourced reports; regulatory action
